text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... Buena. The other day, the girl at 
the tripe stew place suddenly told me to 
do some deep cleaning. Said when you're 
broke, you'll find seed money behind the 
rug...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, guess you didn't get the 
reference. Ahhhh... well—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Go pay Jordan a visit. You'd 
love getting your nails done nice and 
pretty, wouldn't ya?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Fufu. What's the matter, 
Nakayama-san? All of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Nakayama-san, you're weird 
sometimes. Unpredictable, amusing... and 
warm.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's precisely because you are who 
you are that you gave me so much energy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Next time you cry, do it where 
nobody can see ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Don't put me on display like that, 
please.
